character.name: Ling
character.description:
Deals <@ba.kw>Arts damage</>
Can use <@ba.kw>Summons</> in battles
character.itemUsage: Ling, poet from Yan, unchecked and unbridled, content as she wishes. As long as she has wine, anything can go into her poems.
character.itemDesc: You ask where her poet's brush is? Take a good look at her tail.
